note: the Default policy's rule forms, which stand over policy.json in a build with --default: each value a share or a multiple of what is measured, none of them one servo's number. The policy of record states the same six entries fixed

why.yield: how hard a stalled horn keeps pushing is the application's: with no yield torque a metal train keeps the cap, no fold, and a sustained press ends at the 90 C winding cutoff; a plastic train takes the plastic torque limit: the owner's decision
why.plastic_torque_limit_kg_cm: not known yet: the SG90's tooth slip, about 0.3 A static, through the SG90's Kt, the gear ratio and the train's efficiency, which an SG90 identification gives
why.stall_release: it moves with the yield current, at the record's ratio, 90 over 250, of the yield current as the kernel runs it: the owner's decision
why.stall_speed: four times the speed noise of a still shaft: the owner's decision
why.pot_jump: four times the worst healthy value of the statistic the screen tests, the worst run of 4 successive RAIL-period steps over the run's driven rows and its wide-code holds, outside its pot holes: the owner's decision
why.current_loop: the current loop at a multiple of the electrical corner it closes on, R over 2 pi L: on the record 1013.6 Hz against the bench sweep's 1 kHz
why.observer: the observer at a multiple of the mechanical corner, Ke^2 over 2 pi J R: on the record 15.12 Hz against the bench sweep's 15 Hz
